extName.description: Extension name shown in Web Store and browser

extDesc.message: Save content you find on the web — image, text, creator, source and all — into a searchable library on your PC. Private by design.
extDesc.description: Extension description shown in Web Store

actionInjectUnreadable.message: Hologram: can't start saving — the extension's own files can't be read. Reload it at chrome://extensions.
actionInjectUnreadable.description: Toolbar tooltip when the extension's own files can no longer be read, so injecting the capture UI fails on every page

actionInjectRefused.message: Hologram: couldn't start saving on this page
actionInjectRefused.description: Toolbar tooltip when the extension is healthy but this particular page refused the injection

optionsSavedBadge.message: Mark on posts you've already saved
optionsSavedBadge.description: Options group label for the timeline saved-post mark

optionsSavedBadgeDesc.message: Shows a small mark on timeline images that are already in your Hologram library. The check happens entirely on this computer.
optionsSavedBadgeDesc.description: Options description for the timeline saved-post mark

optionsSavedBadgeHover.message: Only while pointing at the post
optionsSavedBadgeHover.description: Options choice: show the saved mark only while pointing at the post

optionsSavedBadgeAlways.description: Options choice: show the saved mark whenever the post is on screen

optionsSavedBadgeOff.description: Options choice: never show the saved mark

optionsHoverSave.message: Show a save button when you point at a post
optionsHoverSave.description: Options label for the hover save button

optionsHoverSaveDesc.message: Shows one save button for each unsaved post. It saves every image or video in the post together with its text, creator and source URL. Posts without media can also be saved.
optionsHoverSaveDesc.description: Options description for the hover save button

ctxSaveMedia.description: Context menu item: save the selected image

ctxImportSaved.description: Context menu item: import the current saved-post list

ctxImportSavedPosts.description: Context menu item: start import mode for saved posts
